hook_text: No phones this weekend. We built this.

song.title: Up In The Treehouse
song.style: English, bright indie pop with handclaps, glockenspiel and acoustic guitar, warm friendly male lead vocal, slightly raspy with a sweet child backing vocal, 116 BPM
song.lyrics:
[Verse]
Saturday the phone went on the fridge
Niece came over with a plan and a wish
Hammer, nails and a pile of wood
Built it crooked but it's built for good

[Chorus]
Up in the treehouse, up in the leaves
Nobody finds us except the breeze
Up in the treehouse, way up high
Closer to the clouds and the big blue sky

[Verse]
Wonky roof and a rope for a door
Lemonade and a sleeping bag floor
Counted stars until we lost the count
An owl came by to check us out

[Chorus]
Up in the treehouse, up in the leaves
Best weekend you would ever believe
Up in the treehouse, way up high
Phone's asleep and so am I

shots.prompt: {moss} and his little niece with two puffy pigtails and a red dress wave from the window of a wonky treehouse high in a big oak tree. Low angle, static. Bright blue sky.

A hand slides a black smartphone face-first into a small rounded moss-green brick stuck to a white fridge door, the phone settling upright. The brick has a round pale yellow disc on its front. Warm kitchen light drifts across the fridge. Static close-up, the camera eases back slightly as the hand pulls away.
his little niece with two puffy pigtails and a red dress holds up a crayon drawing of a treehouse and {moss} gasps with excitement. Static medium shot. Warm morning light.
{moss} hammers a plank onto a tree branch while his little niece with two puffy pigtails and a red dress holds it steady. Static medium shot. Dappled sunlight.
{moss} and his little niece with two puffy pigtails and a red dress lift a crooked little roof into place; it tilts and they both laugh. Static wide shot. Golden afternoon light.
{moss} climbs up a rope ladder after his little niece with two puffy pigtails and a red dress into the treehouse. The camera tilts up. Dappled light.
{moss} and his little niece with two puffy pigtails and a red dress sip lemonade at the treehouse window, swinging their legs. Static medium shot. Warm late light.

At night {moss} and his little niece with two puffy pigtails and a red dress lie in sleeping bags looking up at the stars through the treehouse roof, and an owl lands on a branch beside them. Static medium shot. Deep blue moonlight.
Sunrise over the crooked treehouse in the big oak, birds waking up in the branches. The camera slowly pulls back. Peach and gold, calm.

caption: Moss and his niece put the phone in the Hibernator for a weekend and built a very crooked treehouse.
